theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → LipschitzWith L f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → G x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → ∃ (Φ : ℕ → Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω : ℕ → Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (h : ℕ → Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (W : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (Ω i)) ∧ (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K (Φ i) (Ω i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω i, ∀ w' ∈ Ω i, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ i w - Φ i w'‖) ∧ (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, W i ⊆ M) ∧ (∀ i, W i ⊆ Φ i '' Ω i) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint W) ∧ (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ ⋃ i, W i) = 0 ∧ ∀ i, ∀ w ∈ Ω i, Φ i w ∈ W i → f (Φ i w) = h i w ∧ G (Φ i w) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Φ i) w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ u, inner ℝ (G (Φ i w)) (fderiv ℝ (Φ i) w u) = fderiv ℝ (h i) w u
